source_text: Ex Aegypto portaverunt sparsum; deficiente manna pluit; ad terram sanctam fructus palmarum — manna defecit. Tres cibi: eruditio saecularis exigua; in eremo vitae huius manna legis divinae; qui terram repromissionis intrat edit fructus palmarum — facie ad faciem quae oculus non vidit. Secundum litteram melior cibus cessare et deterior succedere absurdum; spiritalis intelligentia verior. Post introitum Iesus celebrat pascha.
pass_a_gloss: From Egypt they-carried dough; with-it-failing manna rained; unto land holy fruits of-palms — manna failed. Three foods: learning worldly small; in desert of-life this manna of-law divine; who land of-promise enters eats fruits of-palms — face unto face things which eye not saw. According-to letter better food to-cease and worse to-succeed absurd; spiritual understanding truer. After entrance Jesus celebrates passover.
pass_b_english: Leaving Egypt they carried dough; when it failed, manna rained; in the holy land they ate palm-country fruit — [[manna ceased >> Bible:Joshua 5:12]]. Three foods: scant school learning from Egypt; in this life’s desert, manna of divine instruction; whoever enters the promised land eats palm fruits — [[face to face what eye has not seen >> Bible:1 Corinthians 2:9; 13:12]]. If only the letter stands, better food would yield to worse — absurd; spiritual sense is truer. After bringing his people in, Jesus keeps the Passover.
